notes.title: Winter Sale
notes.content:
What better way to celebrate the festive season than with some [b]Gloom and Doom[/b]? Pick up the game during the Steam Winter Sale for a jolly big discount! 

The sale starts 20th Dec and goes ho ho ho all the way till 3rd Jan 2025! Yippy ki yay, visual novel fans!

notes.title: Steam Scream!
notes.content:
Halloween is all about horror, so what sounds more horrible? Being haunted by a ghost in a decrepit old mansion, or being stuck as a ghost haunting a decrepit old mansion for eternity? 

If that sounds like an interesting premise, then bring some Gloom and Doom to your 2023 Halloween since it's on sale!

notes.title: Steam Visual Novel Fest
notes.content: I don't ever recall a Visual Novel Fest on Steam, but since there is one now, it seems fitting to include Gloom and Doom and to celebrate by slashing the price with a massive 80% discount.

notes.title: See you at Level Up KL 2022!
notes.content:
I'm stoked that Gloom and Doom is a finalist at the SEA Games Awards 2022, and thus I'll be there this week showing my little game as part of the Showcase from Oct 6-7! Drop by and say hi if you're there!

To celebrate, Gloom and Doom will be 50% off all this week!

notes.title: Limited 50% discount
notes.content:
Gloom and Doom is participating in The Nightmarket Festival 2022, and is 50% OFF until Aug 8 10am PST!

The Nightmarket Festival 2022 is showcasing around 100 discounted games, and offering free demos for dozens of hot upcoming titles!

The sale runs from Aug 4-8 10am PST. And includes live broadcasts to celebrate and showcase the lineup. 

The Nightmarket Festival 2022 is the first-ever Steam sales event focusing on promoting games from the SEA region, breaking cultural barriers, and raising awareness for the region’s gaming scene. We introduce awesome games with a local touch, just like the night market culture commonly seen here -- filled with creativity, diversity, and great fun.

Check out the Nightmarket Festival at [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/nightmarketfest_2022]this link[/url]!

notes.title: Judgment Day Discount
notes.content:
August 29 is Judgment Day, according to my favorite movie! And since this is the 30th anniversary of that movie, I'm going to celebrate with a 30% discount!

With those clues and this key visual, can you work out which movie it is?

notes.title: Special 1-week offer
notes.content: Last week, someone told me that based on the amount of references in Gloom and Doom, they decided to go and check out The Cure and they liked it! I found this so fulfilling and validating that I decided to celebrate with a special discount this week!

notes.content: Due to popular demand, the textboxes and choice buttons in the game have been redone to be a bit prettier. Apologies for the shifting graphics in the past update, but this should be it for a while.
